patch_description: This crossover version keeps the stronger parts of the later feature sets while reducing regime fragility and prediction collapse. It emphasizes shorter lookbacks, rolling z-score normalization, volatility/trend change features, and a few high-signal interactions such as momentum × volatility regime. The model is regularized more conservatively than the current baseline to improve out-of-sample slope without overfitting. Feature count stays well under the 80-feature limit and all transformations use only past data.
